source_name: Deloitte Slovenija — Digital Banking Maturity 2020 (SI-language page)
why_relevant: Slovenian-language write-up of the DBM study with SI-specific commentary (4,900 customers surveyed, 19 scenarios, SI banks ranked as digital laggards). Local-language framing often names SI banks and channels not in the regional English deck.

source_name: Deloitte CE Banking Outlook (8 CE countries incl. Slovenia)
why_relevant: Recurring Deloitte Central Europe banking-sector outlook explicitly covering Slovenia among 8 CE markets; carries sector sizing, digitalisation and channel analysis with SI cuts.

source_name: Deloitte CEE M&A Banking Study (annual)
why_relevant: Annual Deloitte study of CEE banking consolidation with per-country chapters; the SI chapter tracks market concentration (NLB, OTP acquisitions), asset shares and competitive structure — context for card/acquiring market share shifts.

source_name: PwC Slovenia — Publications (strategic & operational consulting)
why_relevant: Local PwC office publication index — the entry point for any SI-specific banking/payments paper PwC issues; also the route to CEE FS reports that PwC SI localises.

source_name: EY Slovenija — Vpogledi / Insights
why_relevant: EY's Slovenian insights feed; carries local surveys (e.g. EY podjetniški barometer) and localised FS content. Best single entry point for EY SI banking/payments material, which is not indexed well by search.

source_name: KPMG in Slovenia (kpmg.com/si) — financial services practice & insights
why_relevant: KPMG SI names financial services as a key segment; the local site is the pointer to any SI banking survey or CEE report localisation. No SI-specific banking report surfaced in search, so this is a watch-point rather than a proven data source.

source_name: GlobalData — Slovenia Cards and Payments: Opportunities and Risks to 2028
why_relevant: The single most SI-specific commercial market-sizing product for cards/payments: transaction values and volumes by instrument (cash, cards, credit transfers, direct debits, cheques), issuer/scheme market shares, and 5-year forecasts. Free abstract already yields headline figures (e.g. cash >40% of payment volume; card transaction value ~USD 12.2bn 2023, >8% CAGR 2024-28).

source_name: ResearchAndMarkets — Slovenia Cards and Payments Statistical Yearbook
why_relevant: Reseller listing of an SI cards/payments statistical yearbook (historical series plus forecasts). Table-of-contents pages on this aggregator reveal the exact metric list (cards in circulation, POS/ATM counts, per-instrument volumes) even without purchase — useful for knowing what series exist.

source_name: Argus Advisory Research — Slovenia Cards & Payments country report
why_relevant: Specialist cards/payments research house with a dedicated Slovenia country report — an independent second opinion on card volumes, issuer shares and acquiring, useful to triangulate against GlobalData and Banka Slovenije official series.

source_name: Statista Market Insights — Digital Payments Slovenia (and sub-segments)
why_relevant: Modelled SI market sizing and 5-year forecasts across digital commerce, mobile POS payments, digital remittances and digital banks. Values are model estimates, not observed data — useful for forecast framing and cross-checks, not as ground truth.

source_name: Mastercard Masterindex — Slovenian payment-habits consumer survey
why_relevant: The recurring branded consumer survey on Slovenian payment habits (card penetration ~90%+, weekly card use, contactless perception, mobile-app payment share, cash-retention preference). No public body produces this attitudinal series; results are released via SI media and industry bodies rather than a stable Mastercard page.

source_name: Valicon (SI market-research agency) — consumer and financial-services research
why_relevant: Slovenia's most-cited independent survey house; runs consumer-sentiment and sector trackers whose results (spending behaviour, bank/brand perception) are quoted in SI business media. Bridges the gap between official statistics and attitudinal data on cash vs card.

source_name: Zveza potrošnikov Slovenije / consumer-advocacy mystery-shopping studies (via RTV SLO coverage)
why_relevant: Independent mystery-shopping research on SI banks' basic payment accounts — reveals distribution/access practice and per-bank behaviour that no statistical series captures. Indirect: reveals market conduct rather than reporting volumes.

source_name: RUL — Repozitorij Univerze v Ljubljani (theses on payments/cards/banking)
why_relevant: Full-text SI university repository. Master's/diploma theses on kartično poslovanje, brezgotovinsko plačevanje and mobilne denarnice routinely reproduce SI card/interchange/POS tables and cite otherwise-hard-to-reach industry data. Excellent for historical series and for surfacing terminology and actor names.

source_name: CEK — Digital library of the Faculty of Economics, University of Ljubljana
why_relevant: Faculty of Economics (Ekonomska fakulteta UL) full-text thesis archive; the SI academic centre for payment-systems and fintech research. Hosts theses with SI-specific card/interchange and e-banking penetration tables (e.g. e-banking use by population share).

source_name: IER — Inštitut za ekonomska raziskovanja (Institute for Economic Research), Ljubljana
why_relevant: Slovenia's main autonomous non-governmental economic research institute (macro/micro analysis, micro-econometrics on administrative and survey data, contract research for EU/World Bank/OECD). A likely producer of commissioned studies touching household finance and payment behaviour.

source_name: SICRIS / COBISS CRIS — Slovenian current research information system
why_relevant: National registry of SI research organisations, researchers, projects and bibliographies. The systematic way to enumerate every SI academic/think-tank output on plačilni sistemi, kartično poslovanje and fintech — a pointer that snowballs into authors, institutes and funded projects.

source_name: McKinsey Global Payments Report / Global Payments Map
why_relevant: McKinsey's Global Payments Map covers 25+ payment products across 47 countries and explicitly includes Slovenia in its country estimates; the annual report supplies revenue-pool and instrument-mix framing for SI that no local source produces.

source_name: ISI Markets — CEE Banking Sector Report (annual)
why_relevant: Regional banking-sector research covering CEE with competitive-intensity scoring that explicitly discusses Slovenia (reclassified after OTP and NLB acquisitions). Useful market-structure aggregator alongside the Big Four.

source_name: Računalniške novice — recurring coverage of SI payment-habits research
why_relevant: SI tech-business outlet that reliably republishes vendor and agency payment-habit survey findings (Masterindex waves, contactless and mobile-payment adoption percentages). Practical capture channel for study results whose originals sit behind vendor PR, not a primary source.

source_name: Javna agencija RS za varstvo konkurence (AVK) — arhiv odločb / decisions archive
why_relevant: Slovenian competition authority publishes full decisions (odločbe), including merger clearances involving banks and payment/processing entities. Merger decisions routinely contain market definitions and market-share estimates for card acquiring, issuing, ATM networks and retail banking that participants otherwise do not disclose.

source_name: AVK — priglašene koncentracije in odločitve (notified concentrations and decisions)
why_relevant: Running list of notified M&A in Slovenia. Bank/payment-sector notifications (e.g. bank consolidation such as NKBM/Abanka historically) are the earliest public signal of structural change in the SI banking and payments market, ahead of any statistical publication.

source_name: AVK — letna poročila (annual reports)
why_relevant: Annual report enumerates cases opened/closed by sector, including consumer-credit and financial-services analyses covering named banks, branches and savings banks; gives caseload counts and sectoral focus that indicate where competition pressure on fees is being examined.

source_name: AVK — raziskave (sector inquiries / market studies)
why_relevant: AVK publishes standalone market studies (it has done so for digital platforms, district heating, etc.). This is the channel where any future study of card fees, acquiring or ATM access would appear, with quantitative market data.

source_name: Zveza potrošnikov Slovenije (ZPS) — primerjalnik bančnih računov in paketov
why_relevant: Independent consumer-association comparison tool covering ~15 banks and savings banks in Slovenia, with per-bank fee structures for accounts, cards, ATM withdrawals and online banking. Provides bank-level pricing data usable as a proxy for competitive positioning and fee trends.

source_name: ZPS — tržni pregledi in aktualne vsebine (market reviews, consumer rights articles)
why_relevant: ZPS market reviews cover basic payment account rights, card-fraud handling, and outcomes of consumer disputes with banks; they frequently publish aggregate statistics (e.g. success rates in out-of-court disputes) not available elsewhere.

source_name: Banka Slovenije — Pritožbe uporabnikov finančnih storitev (PUFS) / complaints channel
why_relevant: Central bank's consumer-complaint intake and its periodic reporting on complaint volumes and themes for payment services; complaint mix is a leading indicator of friction in cards, ATM access and fee practices.
